correctness.rationale: An exact Ewens tagged-cycle beta-binomial mixture yields the integral expectation after integration by parts. Differentiation of finite theta-weighted sums gives Cov(K,E)=theta*d/dtheta E[E]. For even n the resulting integral is strictly negative. For odd n, its two signed halves have a strictly decreasing ratio in theta because their supports lie on opposite sides of 1/2; strict concavity proves positivity at theta=1 and a support bound proves negativity at large theta. Hence the crossover exists, is unique and exceeds 1. Uniform endpoint Laplace estimates give theta_n->1 and (theta_n-1)log n-log log n->0. The included standard-library verifier checks 56 exact moment identities via complete permutation enumeration at n=2..8, 64 rational sign cases, and seven numerical crossover brackets. Numerical evidence is corroboration only.
risks: Laplace asymptotics use compact-parameter uniformity, justified by exponential domination near the two endpoints; no unverified numerical step is used to prove the limit.

originality.rationale: Inspected Lugo 2009 sections 1-3 (specifically Lemma 1.2, Proposition 2.4 and the restricted-parity section) and Maples-Nikeghbali-Zeindler 2012 sections 1 and 3. Lugo supplies the general fixed-cycle expectation from which the mean even mass is summable, but it neither states nor directly proves the theta-dependent, n-parity covariance sign theorem and its unique crossover with logarithmic boundary layer. Maples et al treat total-cycle CLTs under cycle weights. An earlier cutoff-count covariance result concerns the number of cycles above a length threshold, not even-cycle total vertex mass, and does not imply the unique parameter threshold. Search failures alone are not used as proof of priority. Residual risk is indirect coverage by a broad parity-statistic treatment.
residual_risks: The tagged-cycle beta-binomial and complete marginal means are classical; historical papers with broader parity functionals may imply the specific strict sign law without explicitly naming it.
Published coverage outside the inspected primary papers and semantic searches cannot be exhaustively ruled out; independent priority review remains outstanding.

Lugo 2009: background motivation of length-parity structures
Maples et al 2012: relevance of cycle-count behavior to weighted permutations
value.rationale: The central statistics capture complementary features of the same random partition: global cycle complexity and the vertex mass belonging to a parity-defined class. The theorem gives a nontrivial all-order sign dichotomy, a unique finite-parameter transition in odd orders, and a sharp (log log n)/(log n) boundary for its location. These properties are not ordinary one-line consequences of cycle-count marginals and can inform sensitivity of parity composition to Ewens cycle-weight tuning.
risks: The theorem does not yield a joint limit distribution or a direct application beyond the structural dependence profile; its value is a self-contained exact probabilistic classification.
